name: Emberbrand (EMF content example)
description: Adds a new sword, the Emberbrand (a Bronze Sword with more damage and fire). Get it with EMF (put/give). Craft it in the own crafting menu (weapons, 5 wood logs). It also adds the Ember Table, a table to place in your base (supplies, 4 wood logs). An example of new content with fixed GUIDs; everyone in a game needs the same mod.
